## Named Storms Per Year by Type

The following visualization displays the number of unique named storms per year, broken down by storm type (tropical depressions, tropical storms, and hurricanes), in the `dplyr::storms` dataset.

```{r plot-storms}
storms |> 
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |> 
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) |> 
  group_by(year, status) |> 
  summarize(n_storms = n_distinct(name), .groups = "drop") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_storms, fill = status)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "#9ecae1", # Light Blue
      "tropical storm" = "#fdae61",      # Orange
      "hurricane" = "#d73027"            # Dark Red
    ),
    labels = c(
      "tropical depression" = "Tropical Depression",
      "tropical storm" = "Tropical Storm",
      "hurricane" = "Hurricane"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Named Storms per Year by Type",
    subtitle = "Data source: dplyr::storms",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Named Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type"
  )
```
